newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust completes Brazil loan.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust completes Brazil loan.

text.p: Bankers Trust Co and Itau Bankers Trust-Banco de Investimentos S.A. said on Wednesday a bank syndicate led by Bankers Trust completed funding a $275 million loan on behalf of Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Economico e Social (BNDES), Brazil's national development bank.
The banks said the deal is the first internationally syndicated medium-term loan to a Brazilian borrower since 1982.

"The loan was very well received by the bank market as demonstrated by the initial loan amount of $150 million at launch to $275 million at closing," said Fiona Paulus, managing director of the Brazil international corporate finance group at BT Securities Corp.

The banks said the recent upgrade of Brazil's sovereign debt by Standard & Poor's to BB-minus from B-plus has had a positive impact on the loan. BNDES' spread over LIBOR fell to 1.625 percent from 2.00 percent.

Bankers Trust said the loan was co-arranged by Banco Santander SA and BankAmerica Corp. Bankers Trust said 26 banks from 12 countries participated, and the group included many institutions which are lending to Brazil for the first time.
